headline: Reads directly assigned to lineage, genotype, and methylation state without reference…
label: Sequencing Read Genotyping Tools
summary: Automated pipelines now apply read-level typing to viral, M. tuberculosis, and wastewater sequencing data, including long-read and barcoded Nanopore workflows.
synthesis: The dominant thread is assigning identity, lineage, or genotype directly from sequencing reads. Pathotypr uses alignment-free k-mer features and Random Forest for MTBC lineage and WHO-catalogue resistance calling from assemblies and reads, while WEPP places wastewater reads onto mutation-annotated trees to resolve near-haplotype abundances. Nextstrain applies daily phylodynamic analysis to open sequence data for 21 viruses and M. tuberculosis. Newer items address upstream read handling specific to long-read and barcoded workflows. deluxpore demultiplexes Nanopore reads from Illumina dual-indexed libraries using BLAST and Levenshtein matching, BCAR uses per-base quality evidence during barcode-sequence mapping and consensus generation, and methbiome profiles DNA methylation from Nanopore and PacBio metagenomes against a reference. KuafuPrimer applies few-shot machine learning to 16S primer design aimed at reduced bias. The set is heterogeneous, so the shared element is read-level inference rather than a single method.
